title: Machine Learning Model for an App-Based Tool to Assist With the Diagnosis of Canine Atopic Dermatitis.
summary: Methods describe cases from board-certified clinicians and train/test procedure; Results report diagnostic sensitivity and specificity on the held-out cases. Testing: Methods describe cases from board-certified clinicians and train/test procedure; Results report diagnostic sensitivity and specificity on the held-out cases.. A Random Forest app model distinguished clinically diagnosed canine atopic dermatitis from other dermatoses using referral cases and a stratified held-out evaluation.
